summary.text: Patrick O'Connell is the Republican candidate for the Michigan State Senate, District 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a former small-business owner who later worked in insurance.

paragraphs.text: O'Connell graduated from Schafer High School.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he adopted four sons as a single father and is a foster parent, and that he owned Fisher Wallpaper and Paint in Wyandotte before moving into the insurance industry and working with several State Farm agents.
O'Connell advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
He said his campaign centers on lowering everyday costs, including housing, childcare and property taxes, protecting individual freedoms from government overreach, and addressing crime and drugs.
